items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I did a lot of records for him during that period.

ctx.x: Yes, for Moe Asch. I did a lot of records for him during that period. I did a couple of sessions for Victor. That was "Waltz Boogie". That was the first time, you know, that 3/4 was ever recorded, I mean, composed into 3/4.
